status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.check_failed: Cannot check this state. Start the application or refresh after resolving the service error.
status.worker_help: An idle one-shot worker is normal. The native timer wakes it for queued jobs.
status.scorer_configured: Optional scoring configured; text fallback remains available. Provider quality and connectivity are not tested here.
status.text_fallback: Text search works without optional providers. This check does not send data to inference services.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose the application hostname, certificate and optional NethServer sign-in settings. Saving starts the dedicated database and C0 application.
settings.host_help: DNS name pointing to this NS8 node, without https:// or a path.
settings.host_invalid: Enter a valid fully qualified DNS hostname.
settings.certificate_help: HTTPS is handled by NethServer. With this option off, NethServer uses its configured certificate. Certificate requests require public DNS and network access.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This hostname is already used by another application.
settings.certificate_failed: Certificate request failed. Check the DNS and network settings, then retry or disable the certificate request.
settings.owner_help: An existing account in the selected user domain. Ownership is pinned to its LDAP identity; the cluster administrator login is separate.
settings.sharing_help: The owner has Admin access. Additional Reader, Editor or Admin accounts are admitted in the C0 application after their first sign-in attempt.
settings.auth_options_failed: Cannot load user domains or identity providers. Verify the NS8 account domain and ns8-idp setup.
settings.identity_required: Select an identity provider, user domain and owner account.
settings.identity_invalid: Verify the selected domain/provider and the existing owner account.
settings.retrieval_privacy: Embedding providers receive extracted text and search queries. Relevance scorers receive queries and bounded evidence excerpts. Keep disabled until the provider and data handling are approved. Text search works without them.
settings.key_saved: A key is saved. Leave blank to preserve it on the same endpoint.
settings.key_empty: No key is saved. Changing the endpoint clears its existing key.
settings.embedding_send_dimensions: Send dimensions to a compatible provider
settings.threshold_help: Calibrate this probability threshold for the pinned model and corpus. Mock test scores do not demonstrate real model quality.
settings.limit_candidates: Ranking candidates (at least returned results, at most 64)
settings.retrieval_invalid: Invalid retrieval settings. Check HTTPS endpoints, pinned models, keys and numeric limits.
settings.session_policy_help: Ordinary website sign-ins can renew for up to 8 hours by default, with a 1-hour inactivity limit. Remember this device uses a separate fixed seven-day website inactivity window. Set limits from 60 to 86400 seconds; inactivity must not exceed the maximum. The provider can end a session earlier. Existing sessions retain their original limits, and changing these settings never extends them.
settings.session_policy_invalid: Enter whole seconds from 60 to 86400, with inactivity no longer than the maximum duration.
settings.connection_policy_help: Users explicitly approve background access for each app. New connections expire after this many days without use. Active connections have no fixed maximum duration. Changing this setting does not change existing connections. Website sign-in has its own inactivity limit. Assistant activity never keeps a browser signed in.
settings.connection_policy_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
settings.personal_data_error_account_blocked: User access is blocked in C0
settings.personal_data_error_identity_ambiguous: Source identity could not be verified
settings.personal_data_error_provider_mismatch: The source uses a different user provider; import is stopped
settings.personal_data_error_inventory_incomplete: Source scan incomplete; no deletion inferred
settings.personal_data_error_too_large: Source item exceeds the supported size
settings.personal_data_disable_help: Disabling removes imported content. Personal spaces and separately authored content are retained.
settings.personal_data_limits: Only instances using the same user provider are available. NethCTI requires a usable user session or token. Mail scans can be incomplete; uncertain absences do not delete imported content. Each pass visits up to five people and reads five historical items plus five recent items per source. Coverage shows inventories overdue by 24 hours; large backlogs can delay collection.
settings.personal_data_unverified: Source capabilities have not been verified.
settings.personal_data_required: Select at least one compatible instance and enable company sign-in.
settings.personal_data_state_reconciled: API traversal completed; deletion coverage is limited
settings.personal_data_inventory_overdue: Complete inventory is overdue or has not been verified
